budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Chair presented the accounts payable warrant, which the Board then signed.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Damage to Library materials from the burst pipes was totaled.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The total annual MIIA credit available to the town was stated, with at least half eligible this year.

budget_items.quote: chapter 70 will receive an increase of 2.4% and unrestricted general government aid will have a 3.6% increase

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Berlin's dispatch equipment replacement cost was reported as part of the regional dispatch feasibility discussion.
budget_items.quote: berlin needs all their equipment replaced in the amount of $250,000 to $400,000.
